messages:
From: Ada Lin <ada@orchard.ai>

Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Prepay options for Stage A — rough forecast attached

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the product walkthrough last week — really appreciated the clarity on latency controls and the Dedicated options. As we discussed, Orchard is a Series A startup with a constrained cash runway but a clear growth plan for the next 12–24 months. We want to explore a committed prepay to get a meaningful unit discount + developer credits to help onboarding.

High-level forecast (attached):
- Month 1–3: 40k tokens/day (mostly dev/eval)
- Month 4–9: ramp to ~200k tokens/day as we move to production
- Month 10–24: steady-state 300–500k tokens/day depending on feature rollout

Asks:
1) What discount can you offer for a 12-month vs 24-month prepay?
2) Would Redwood consider a ramped minimum (low in months 1–3, step-up months 4–9) instead of a flat commit?
3) Any dev/onboarding credits you can include (Doc credits, trial credits, or surcharge credits)?

We attached the rough forecast (Orchard_usage_forecast.xlsx). We need to present a capex/opex comparison to the board by 2/20; any quick numbers would be hugely helpful.

Cheers,
Ada
Head of Platform
Orchard Analytics

[Attachment: Orchard_usage_forecast.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Ada Lin <ada@orchard.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 11:17:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Prepay options for Stage A — rough forecast attached

Hi Ada — thanks for the forecast and the clear asks. Attaching two quick options for modeling while we align internally:

Option A — 12-month prepay (fast ramp)
- 15% unit discount off hosted rates
- Ramped minimum: 25% of committed token volume for months 1–3, 60% months 4–6, 100% after month 7
- $25k developer/onboarding credit applied in Q1 (consumable against usage)
- No early termination credit refund

Option B — 24-month prepay (term discount + credits)
- 22% unit discount off hosted rates
- Smoothed ramp: 35% months 1–3, 70% months 4–9, 100% thereafter
- $60k developer/onboarding credit + 2 weeks of implementation support from Solutions
- Ability to convert to Dedicated (reserved capacity) at Year 2 at a pre-negotiated rate

Notes/asks for you: can you confirm whether the majority of tokens are text-generation (chat) vs embeddings? That changes our kernel selection for Dedicated and the unit economics. Also confirm whether you need data isolation/access to Private earlier in the term.

I put in an internal note to loop Sales Ops for legal/PO terms if you like one of these. Happy to hop on a 30-min call to walk through numbers with your finance lead.

Best,
Priyom
Account Executive — Redwood Inference

[Attachment: Redwood_prepay_options_v2.pdf (application/pdf)]

Marissa, Karthik — looping you both for quick input. Ada from Orchard (Series A, likely <$8M ARR run-rate) wants a prepay with ramped minimums. My preliminary options above; asking:

- Discount guidance: for Stage A startups do we want to go to 22% for 24mo? or is 15% 12mo/22% 24mo too aggressive for our sales comp math?
- Credits: can we push $60k dev credits on 24mo? It helps lock the deal but impacts near-term revenue recognition.
- Conversion to Dedicated: good upsell motion but needs to be non-ambiguous in SOW (pricing floor).

Deal context: small logo, potential ARR growth if they hit mid-market; Sales will treat this as a strategic early adopter case. Proposed deal_id RDW-2026-0197.

Thanks — I can take a call with Ada after we align.

—Priyom

Thanks Priyom — I appreciate the clear options. Couple of clarifications from our side:

1) Token mix: ~75% text generation (chat), ~25% embeddings for semantic search and ranking.
2) Budget: our finance lead has max committed Opex of $420k for year 1; we can stretch to $700k if there are onboarding credits and a better blended unit price.
3) Ramp flexibility: we can't front-load a high minimum in months 1–3; need that to be lower (10–20%) and ability to true-up against actual usage at quarter ends.

If you can do: 18-month term with ~20% effective discount + $45k onboarding credits + quarter-end true-up to smooth the ramp, we can sign and fast-track PO/board note. Also if you can include a short pilot credit to cover our first month of prod traffic that would be decisive.

Can we get a short term sheet by EOD Friday (2/13)?

Best,
Ada

Ada — thanks, and really helpful budget color. Based on internal alignment here is a near-final commercial term sheet we can take to PO/legal: 

Proposal (18-month hybrid) — RDW-2026-0197
- Effective unit discount: 20% off hosted published rates (blended across chat + embeddings)
- Commitment: annualized token spend equivalent to your forecast, with an 18-month term
- Ramped minimums: 15% months 1–3, 50% months 4–6, 85% months 7–12, 100% months 13–18
- Quarter-end true-up: any shortfall below the minimum in a quarter may be true-up billed at committed rates (we offer a 45-day grace window)
- Onboarding credits: $45k applied against first 3 months of invoicing; plus a $10k pilot credit for initial production validation
- Implementation: 2 weeks concierge support from Solutions + 1 architecture review
- Option to convert to Dedicated in month 13 at a pre-agreed rate; conversion requires 60 days notice and an amendment

Next steps: if this looks good, Sales Ops will draft a short SOW + amendment and we'll route to Legal / PO. I included a DocuSign placeholder link in case you want to get the ball rolling: https://app.docusign.com/envelope/RDW-0197-ENG

If you want the numbers modeled at your $420k vs $700k scenarios I can send a quick comparison.

Best,
Priyom
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
